title: Hot reload and a debugger inside the container

videos.script: Building an image for every changed line is slow. This lesson is about the loop while you write code. {{mount}} First, the source mounted into a container that has the tools. A Node service restarts itself when a file changes. Shelf recompiles on a restart. And one trap: a mount hides whatever the image had in that directory. {{watch}} Then Compose watch, which rebuilds the real image whenever a file changes, so what you test is what ships. {{debug}} And last, a debugger. In a container it is one more port, published on localhost and nowhere else.
